about: A string variable is held to the UTF-8 bytes its sce:capacity declares, on every backend. `copy` assigns `body` (sixteen) to `title` (four) and then counts itself: a copy that does not fit is skipped, raises error.execution and ends its block, so `title` and `copied` keep what they held. The bound is bytes, not characters: two characters of two bytes fit, and an `é` and a `€` (two and three bytes) do not. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: the strings start at their declared values
`hello` is five bytes and `title` holds four: the copy is refused and its block ends before `copied` counts it
a literal of exactly four bytes fits the bound
two characters of two bytes each are four bytes, and fit
two characters, five bytes: a count of characters would let it pass, a count of bytes does not
a copy of what fits goes through again once `body` holds less
